source.snippet: Le capital social est fixé à la somme de mille euros (1 000 euros). Il est divisé en 1 000 actions de 1 euro chacune, entièrement libérées correspondant à des apports en numéraire exclusivement.

events.extraction_note: Establishes the initial share capital at €1,000, divided into 1,000 fully-paid cash shares of €1 each. This is the foundational capital setting, not a subsequent increase; reconciles correctly with the known prior state (no prior capital) and the shareholder entry in v0.

source.snippet: Lors de la constitution, la soussignée ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES apporte à la Société, une somme en numéraire de mille euros (1 000 €) correspondant à 1 000 actions de numéraire, d'une valeur nominale d'un euro (1 €) chacune, souscrites en totalité et intégralement libérées.

events.extraction_note: Initial shareholder entry at company incorporation; 1,000 fully-paid shares of €1 each contributed in cash by ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES. Consistent with the company's founding capital.

notes: shares_total unknown at this point: capital changed but the nominal value per share was not yet established from a holder-level snapshot.
